text:
Rowan: Quick UX catch from today's review: bulk edits + CSV import can create a "priority chain" where several rules end up sharing the same numeric slot and the rules list just stacks them with no clue. Suggest a compact inline "Chain" indicator (pill) that shows count and a Resolve action. Priya: Love the idea. Two asks: 1) make the pill keyboard discoverable (tab/index + shortcut) and 2) offer a suggested tiebreaker action (auto-suggest Promote/Demote based on specificity score). Josie: Accessibility nits: pill should have role=button and aria-describedby pointing to a short summary. When a chain appears programmatically (import/paste), announce via aria-live. Example announcer we can include in the a11y checklist: ```
Priority conflict chain detected: "Billing - Auto" vs "Billing - Manual" (3 rules)
``` Also ensure SR-friendly pluralization: "1 rule in chain" vs "3 rules in chain". Marta: From preview/sim side: resolving a single link in the chain should trigger an incremental sim for that route. If user applies the auto-suggest for multiple links, we can batch incremental runs but avoid a full-sim. Also add an optional "Preview ordering" toggle in the resolver overlay so you can see the expected match order without committing. Rowan: UX details: pill label "Chain (3)"; action opens a lightweight overlay that is keyboard-first. Overlay shows a vertical chain graph (A -> B -> C) with small cards for each rule. Primary CTAs: "Move up" / "Move down" per node, keyboard hints (Enter to open actions, Alt+Arrow to re-order). Secondary: "Merge nodes" under More. Merge must require explicit confirmation and show what fields will be combined. Priya: Auto-suggest rules: compute a specificity score (number of selectors + explicit matches) and suggest a promotion of the more specific rule. Show confidence (High/Medium/Low) and allow user to accept or reject. If accepted, call the resolve API with sim_apply=true. Josie: Add small SR flow: when overlay opens, focus lands on the first affected node and announce "Opened chain resolver for Route: Checkout. 3 nodes. Use arrow keys to navigate." Use aria-live for updates when user applies changes. DevBot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1761234567-chain-resolver.png 1 shows pill, overlay with chain graph, auto-suggest chip. Samir: Dev notes: API endpoints proposed: PATCH /routes/:id/resolve-chain {action: "promote|demote|merge|autosuggest", target_rule_id: "uuid", sim_apply: true|false}. POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview {proposed_changes: [...]} -> returns preview match-order metrics. Response should include a minimal route_delta so the sim runner can patch state incrementally. Unit tests: focus return, keyboard nav, aria-live messages, and incremental sim trigger. Marta: Also we should surface a small toast on import: "Priority chain detected in Route: Checkout 1 Review". Toast should be keyboard-focusable and link to the top chain pill. Keep toast in the tray until dismissed. Rowan: Edgecase: cascading chains where multiple disjoint chains exist. Show a pill per affected rule group and let overlay navigate related chains. Add a small "Resolve all suggestions" bulk action but keep it opt-in with preview. Josie: I'll add ARIA snippet variations and a short SR script for acceptance tests. Priya, can you sketch the autosuggest confidence microcopy? Priya: Yep 1 will drop copy in the design spec: "Suggested: Promote 'Billing - Auto' (High confidence)" plus an info tooltip explaining criteria. Samir: I'll draft the incremental sim contract and ensure the sim runner can accept route deltas and re-run only affected route(s). Will flag any perf caveats. Rowan: Great. Next steps: Josie adds a11y artifacts, Samir chips the API draft, Priya and I will prototype the chain graph overlay and keyboard mnemonics for the next UX review. Thanks all. :sparkles:
